source.title: Volvo Truck Corporation, Design and function D13A, bulletin 200 281 01, 2.06
source.access: HTML text on third-party mirror; OEM figures not reproduced

assets.scope: Oil feed through pump/cooler/full-flow filters, main gallery and separate piston cooling circuit. Bypass filtered oil joins piston cooling flow.
Tank to EECU cooler, prefilter, feed pump, main filter and cylinder head; return via overflow to suction and vent to tank.
Cam/rocker driven E3 injector with two electronically controlled valves; cycle overview.

limitations: Functional original SVG diagrams only. No exact scale, pinout, ports, chassis routing, OEM figure replication, repair instruction or all-D13 compatibility. Physical reference and authorized OEM confirmation required.
